messages.content: Repair one existing native SVA using the real violating samples. Return exactly the JSON schema. Choose the assertion_id to replace, and generate its complete new implication expression. All other properties stay unchanged. Explain why the chosen old property misses these samples. No predicate is supplied or corrected for you. Never use the required outcome as an assumption. Use the current pre-NBA sampled meanings of the provided signals. ref_count is the independent count of accepted, uncancelled inputs still awaiting output at this sample. Do not introduce new signals or quantifiers. Every accepted output needs a previously accepted, uncancelled input in the sampled queue. Reset cancels pending inputs. Any output without such an input is forbidden, INCLUDING zero data. Payload value is irrelevant to whether a transaction exists. The wrapper already handles reset; do not mention rst in the expression.
